_doc: Adventure-map town sprites remade cute and chunky (bead bzc.97): dense, tall clusters of buildings round a central landmark in the style of the liked map objects (the roadside inn is the style image), replacing the thin wall rings of faction-towns and towns-3x2. 3x2 towns are requested at 232x176 and seated in the 240x184 canvas; the level towns (Lost World and goblin cities 1-3, the neutral village) at their own canvas sizes. Gate at the bottom centre over the entry cell; no flags. Class contract: docs/art/classes/towns.md. Recipes are never edited after generation: add a new id (new seed) instead.

styleInn.usage: copy only the thick black outline, the pixel size, the chunky rounded shapes, the flat shading with one shadow tone and the slightly-from-above front viewing angle; not the subject, not the colours and not the layout

styleLostWorld.usage: copy the palette, outline thickness, pixel size and the chunky rounded shapes of the huts; not the layout

styleHorde.usage: copy the palette, outline thickness, pixel size and the chunky rounded shapes of the shacks; not the layout

styleRealm.usage: copy the outline thickness, pixel size and the chunky rounded shapes of the houses; not the castle and not the layout

recipes.subject: Subject: the Realm's storybook castle town filling the whole image width: at the back centre a tall fat round castle keep of cream limestone #e6d8b4 with #b3a07a shadows under a big tabard blue #2f6fd0 conical roof with #1f4a8f shadows, two plump round towers with blue cones at either side, crowded in front and at the sides by half-timbered houses with white plaster, dark timbers and warm red-brown roofs #a8492f and a little chapel; across the front a short thick crenellated cream stone wall with a big twin-towered gatehouse and a dark arched gate in the exact middle.

Subject: the Restless' spooky-cute haunted town filling the whole image width: at the back centre a tall crooked gothic cathedral of dark slate #5b5866 with #3a3842 shadows, a pointed bell tower and steep shroud violet #7a4fb5 roofs with #4e2f7a shadows and glowing violet windows, crowded round it a crooked manor house, a round domed mausoleum of bone white stone #d8d0bc, little crypts and leaning cream tombstones; across the front a short thick slate wall topped with black iron railings and a big black iron gate between two fat stone pillars with violet lanterns in the exact middle.

Subject: the goblin Horde's ramshackle scrap fortress town filling the whole image width: at the back centre a tall fat boss hall of riveted light grey tin #b8bcc0 with #7d8288 shadows under a bright hazard yellow #f2c230 roof, a crooked wooden lookout tower beside it, crowded round it tin shacks with yellow roofs, a big tawny spotted hide tent and heaps of scrap; across the front a short thick wall of crooked sharpened log stakes #b8733a with #7a4a22 shadows and a big gate crowned by a cream horned ox skull in the exact middle.

recipes.subject: Subject: the Lost World's cheerful prehistoric tribal town filling the whole image width: at the back centre a huge round chieftain's longhouse with a fat tawny thatch roof and walls of tawny hide with big dark brown spots, a tall cream bone totem with bright red-orange paint beside it, crowded round it plump round huts with tawny thatch roofs and spotted hide walls, dark basalt stones and drying racks; across the front a short thick fence of sharpened tawny logs and in the exact middle a big gate made of a giant cream dinosaur skull whose open jaws are the entrance.

Subject: a small cheerful Lost World camp filling most of the image: three plump round huts with fat tawny thatch roofs and tawny hide walls with big dark brown spots huddled round a tall cream bone totem with bright red-orange paint at the back centre, a dark basalt stone and a little log fence; the front hut's dark doorway at the bottom centre.

Subject: a cheerful Lost World village filling most of the image: at the back centre a big round longhouse with a fat tawny thatch roof and spotted tawny hide walls, crowded round it four plump round thatched huts with spotted hide walls, a cream bone totem with bright red-orange paint and a short fence of sharpened tawny logs across the front with a little bone gate at the bottom centre.

Subject: a tiny cosy neutral hamlet filling most of the image: three plump cottages with golden straw thatch roofs and cream plaster walls huddled round a little stone well, a stacked woodpile and a small barn with a warm red-brown roof #a8492f at the back centre; a dark doorway at the bottom centre.
